objective.text: Fake selected event types while allowing unrelated application listeners to execute.

difficulty.rationale: Predict which listeners remain active under a targeted fake.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Event::fake([OrderPlaced::class]) is active. Both OrderPlaced and AuditRequested have ordinary listeners. What happens when each event is dispatched once?

options.text: Both sets of listeners run, but OrderPlaced is additionally recorded.
options.rationale: For the faked type, recording replaces normal listener execution.
options.misconception: For the faked type, recording replaces normal listener execution.

options.text: OrderPlaced is recorded without its listeners; AuditRequested’s real listeners still run.
options.rationale: A selective fake intercepts matching event types and delegates the others to the original dispatcher.

options.text: OrderPlaced runs normally while AuditRequested is blocked.
options.rationale: This reverses the selected fake list’s meaning.
options.misconception: This reverses the selected fake list’s meaning.

options.text: Both events are recorded and neither set of listeners runs.
options.rationale: That describes faking every event rather than the supplied subset.
options.misconception: That describes faking every event rather than the supplied subset.
